entry.description: remove the `git-broadcast` workflow. Its push and pull request triggers had been commented out, leaving it dispatched by hand only, while it still ran `npx git-broadcast@beta`, a dist-tag that can be repointed at any published version, in a job that checks out with a token able to push to this repository, using mutable action tags and no `permissions` block (CWE-1357) (audit 1231d72-f011)
